title: Fake town/city/suburbs called “oklahoma”
content: This is going to be poorly executed because I just woke up from the dream, I’ve been to this place only once before. It seems like a town/suburbs area, with houses and green fields and trees. This time, I met a guy in my dream and he showed me all around the town, and gave me rules on how not to get caught. It almost seemed like a video game, where we needed to “make it to the end” without getting found out by the “agents” watching us. We would walk around the streets, and occasionally go into houses. Each room in the house seemed like a different level, interacting with different members of the family. There’s one house in particular that I went into in my last dream, and this most recent one. Although this time, the guy I was with was able to break the father of the house out of the “mind control” they were under, causing them to not want to hurt us anymore. I realize how absolutely insane this sounds, but I’ve found nothing about this “fake Oklahoma suburb place”. There was a prison that the guy and I kept getting placed in, every time we got caught. The goal was to escape the prison so we could continue our journey in the town. I eventually found out that the way to keep the “agents” away from us is by singing (and also whenever you finish the “game” you’re met with a certain song. I also met a couple of girls in this place, and they seemed to recognize me from last time I was in this dream place. It seemed to have started daylight but by the end it was night. If any of this sounds familiar, PLEASE comment because I would love to find more information about this place.
